item: D5 Selection of the reported result
support_quote: The scale is divided into five aspects: internal regulation aspect, identity regulation aspect, interjective regulation aspect, external regulation aspect, and motivation ( 22 ).
reasoning: Decided by the user on 2026-11-28 (gate 3, Q1, sentence (a); protocol amendment A10): reporting only the total or composite score of an instrument whose subscales the Methods name is rated Some concerns under D5, unless a registration or protocol named the subscales as outcomes; how the total was formed is rated under D4. The rating is the user's ruling, not the adjudicator's. The adjudicator had escalated this item, and its reasoning was: Both judges read the paper correctly. The Methods name five BREQ-2 aspects, and Table 2 and §3.2 give one total per arm at all three time points. The registration (NCT06216236) gives no date and no outcomes in the saved text. Judge 1 reads the High anchor's 'only some of the subscales' as covering a total reported in place of every subscale. Judge 2 reads it as covering only a subset, which a whole-instrument total is not. The anchor's wording supports both readings. The user's question: when the Methods describe an instrument's subscales and the report gives only a total or composite (no subscale), does that meet D5 High's 'gives only some of the subscales ... that its methods ... say were administered'?

support_quote: The scale is divided into five aspects: internal regulation aspect, identity regulation aspect, interjective regulation aspect, external regulation aspect, and motivation ( 22 ).
reasoning: The only between-group test is on a single BREQ-2 score per arm (Table 2, P 0.936 and 1.000), a composite of subscales of opposite valence, and the paper nowhere states whether it is a sum, a mean or a relative autonomy index. Under amendment A11(a) a composite decides direction only when its formation is stated and its valence follows from it, which fails here, so the code is other; both judges read it the same way, and the P values stay in motivation_result.
